source_lines_after.36: For clarity, a displacement is obtained by starting at a chosen positive point of the base transversal and continuing the loop plaque by plaque through a finite chart subdivision. Within each chart its transverse label is held fixed; the fence specifies the nearby endpoint in that plaque. Since $[f]\in N_j$, the return map is the identity on a sufficiently short interval on side j, so these displacements are closed loops. The quantifier means: there exists $\epsilon_0>0$ such that every displacement with $0<\epsilon<\epsilon_0$ is nullhomotopic in its own leaf. No uniform bound on the filling disks is part of the definition.
